notes.title: Could You Save the World in Just 60 Minutes?
notes.notes: [p][i]You have exactly 60 minutes to save humanity from nuclear extinction. There are no second attempts. No manual saves. Explore a collapsing bunker, repair critical systems, and solve puzzles under pressure. Succeed or watch the world end.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Our upcoming game [b]60 Minutes to Extinction: Escape Room[/b] now has a Steam page![/p][p][/p][p]For this game, we’ve added a twist: the entire game takes place in real time. We’re looking forward to seeing who manages to save humanity in time![/p][p][/p][p]Add it to your wishlist now:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3783210/60_Minutes_to_Extinction_Escape_Room/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thank you,[/p][p]Kiko[/p]

notes.title: Pyramids and Aliens ~ Now Available!
notes.notes:
Dear adventurer,

The wait is over! Pyramids and Aliens: Escape Room is now available on Steam. Dive into a thrilling journey where ancient Egyptian mysteries collide with extraterrestrial intrigue. Solve challenging puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and unravel a story that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Are you ready to face the unknown?

We’d love to hear your thoughts—leaving a review helps us tremendously.
Thanks and enjoy the game!
Kiko

notes.title: Mystic Academy: Escape Room is available again!
notes.notes:
Hello,

We're thrilled to announce the return of our game, now known as Mystic Academy: Escape Room, on Steam! 

We've made some changes to the game plot, setting, characters and puzzles but the core of the puzzles and escape room spirit continues to be the same.

As you probably know, we are a small indie studio and these last few weeks have been stressful. If you've enjoyed our games in the past and want to support us, the best way to do so is by leaving a review on Steam of Mystic Academy: Escape Room.

Thank you for your support,
Kiko
